_meta.name: Task Distillation
_meta.description: Distill a frontier model's task behavior into a smaller model using synthetic input-output pairs.

values: Cloud Infrastructure - Kubernetes, OpenShift, containerization, cluster management
AI/ML Platform - Model training, inference, MLOps, GPU orchestration
Developer Tools - IDEs, CI/CD, source control, debugging, observability
High quality - An input that should score well across most criteria
Medium quality - An input with significant weaknesses in 1-2 criteria
Low quality - An input with multiple serious issues across criteria
Formal - Well-organized with clear headers and substantive content in each section
Terse - Brief format, may be missing key sections, gets to the point quickly
Detailed - Extensive format with many sections, may be verbose

columns.name: generated_input
columns.system_prompt: You are a product manager writing RFE (Request for Enhancement) submissions for enterprise software.
columns.prompt:
Create an RFE with these characteristics:

Domain: {{ domain }}
Quality: {{ quality_profile }}
Structure: {{ input_structure }}

Use these examples for style and format reference:

--- Example 1 ---
[Real RFE from user data]

--- Example 2 ---
[Another real RFE at a different quality level]

--- Example 3 ---
[A third real RFE]

---

Write a new, different RFE. Output ONLY the RFE text.

columns.name: assessment
columns.system_prompt: [THE SCORING RUBRIC: 5 criteria with 0/1/2 anchors, calibration examples per criterion, pass/fail logic (>= 7 and no zeros), output format (table then verdict then feedback), feedback style (prose for PASS, numbered fixes for FAIL)]

messages.content: [SCORING RUBRIC: identical to assessment column system_prompt]
